summary: Kept by esv::hit::RedirectionSystem (Toolkit users ProcessTrackingRequests, FinalizeTrackingRequests, ProcessEntityDestruction, ProcessExecutionRequests): an Array of 32-byte tracking records per entity, rebuilt by bg3.exe+0x2EE5840 (removes the component when the list is empty, otherwise clears the array and copies the new records). Records hold two entity handles (the second resolved through esv::status::OwnershipComponent when a type byte is 3) and several flag bytes. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

fields.name: Boost
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 esv::hit::RedirectionSystem::FinalizeTrackingRequests: iterates the entity's RedirectDamage boosts (BoostsContainerComponent::Get, BoostIteratorSkipUndesiredEntities) and for each kept boost writes into record +0 a local copy of the boost entity handle from that iterator; record stride 0x20.

fields.name: BoostCause
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 FinalizeTrackingRequests: record +8 = eoc::GetBoostCauseOrSource(BoostInfoComponent) of the boost; when the cause type byte (+0x18 of the cause) is 3 it is replaced by the owner from esv::status::OwnershipComponent; the record is kept only if this entity is alive or RedirectToDamageSource is set.

fields.name: DamageType1
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 FinalizeTrackingRequests: byte +4 of eoc::RedirectDamageBoostComponent (Script Extender: DamageType DamageType1) copied here unless 0 (None) or 0x0E (DamageType Sentinel); value of an optional (+0x11 is its has-value flag).

fields.name: HasDamageType1
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 FinalizeTrackingRequests: set to 1 in the same store that writes DamageType1 (the two bytes 1 and the damage type stored together), left 0 when the boost's DamageType1 is None or Sentinel - the has-value byte of an optional DamageType.

fields.name: DamageType2
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 FinalizeTrackingRequests: byte +5 of eoc::RedirectDamageBoostComponent (Script Extender: DamageType DamageType2) copied here unless 0 or 0x0E; value of an optional (+0x13 is its has-value flag).

fields.name: HasDamageType2
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 FinalizeTrackingRequests: set to 1 together with DamageType2 (the byte 1 stored above three lower bytes in one 4-byte write), 0 when the boost's DamageType2 is None or Sentinel.

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 FinalizeTrackingRequests: record +0x14 = the first int32 of eoc::RedirectDamageBoostComponent (Script Extender: int32_t Amount).

fields.name: RedirectToDamageSource
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 FinalizeTrackingRequests: record +0x18 = byte +6 of eoc::RedirectDamageBoostComponent (Script Extender: bool RedirectToDamageSource); the same byte lets the record be kept when the cause entity is dead.

fields.name: _Pad19
fields.evidence: Never written: the three upper bytes of the dword +0x18 keep their cleared value (line 176 `& 0xffffff00`) and the dword +0x1C (uStack_bc) is never assigned; record stride 0x20.

fields.name: Records
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2EE6530 (AllocRaw 0x10) zeroes +0, +8, +0xC (Array pattern); destructor thunk of bg3.exe+0x5946C0 frees the buffer (trivial elements). bg3.exe+0x2EE5840 lines 326-367 set size +0xC to 0, grow with bg3.exe+0x6DA440 and copy 32-byte records to the buffer pointer plus size times 0x20.

open_questions: Each record is one RedirectDamage boost of the entity: Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x3AFD00 FinalizeTrackingRequests copies eoc::RedirectDamageBoostComponent (Amount, DamageType1, DamageType2, RedirectToDamageSource) and the boost's cause. The 0x0E excluded beside 0 is read as DamageType Sentinel; not seen live.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
